text: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc 是为 DSH 提供文档处理能力的工具插件，通过在共享工具注册表中注册 read_document、create_document 和 edit_document，让模型读取 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX、CSV 及常见文本文件，创建 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、CSV 和文本文件，并就地编辑 DOCX、XLSX 与 CSV。读取结果会转换为模型可用的文本；创建支持结构化内容、表格或工作表。适合需要在 DSH 对话中查看资料、生成文档或更新表格的场景。无需额外账号或 API 密钥，可选设置读取上限和 PDF 中文字体路径。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc adds three tools to DSH: read_document extracts PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, and text; create_document makes new files; edit_document updates DOCX, XLSX, or CSV. It supports document lookup, file creation, and spreadsheet updates without an account or API key.
想让 DSH 帮我读取 PDF、Word 或 Excel 文件里的内容。
能不能直接在对话里生成一份 DOCX 或 CSV 文档？
我想让模型修改现有表格中的单元格并追加数据行。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc 的功能「读取文档」：调用 read_document 并提供路径，可将 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX、CSV 和文本内容转换成受长度限制的模型可读文本。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc 的功能「创建和编辑」：create_document 按结构化内容生成文档，edit_document 可就地修改 DOCX、XLSX 或 CSV；创建时不会覆盖已有文件。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 89 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc README · @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Model-facing document tools: read, create and edit PDF / DOCX / XLSX / PPTX / CSV / Markdown files without shelling out to external utilities.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc README · What it does：Legacy binary `.doc` / `.xls` / `.ppt` files are not supported — the tools ask the user to convert them first. PPTX is read-only.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc README · Filesystem seam：Text formats (csv/md/txt/…) read and write through the governed `ctx.fs` seam, so sandbox policy, approval flows and observation events apply as with the native `read`/`write` tools. Binary formats read through `ctx.fs.readBytes` (capped by `readMaxBytes`, default 50 MB) but write to the resolved process path with `node:fs`, because the seam is text-only; sandbox write policy does not fence those binary writes.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc README · Configuration：All optional: `maxTextChars` (read text budget), `readMaxBytes` (binary read cap), `cjkFontPath` (explicit CJK font file for PDF creation — any fontkit-openable TTF/OTF/TTC).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc README · Tool schema：The model sees one schema per tool with a precise per-format description; `edit_document` operations are a `oneOf` discriminated by a const `op`, so the model gets an exact contract for each edit kind.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc README · Tool-call history and result：Read results carry a `<path>/<kind>/<details>/<content>` envelope (bounded text); create/edit results return a one-line acknowledgement with byte counts or per-op summary numbers. Errors are stable Chinese/English message strings describing the rejection (unsupported legacy format, target already exists, unknown worksheet, zero matches, …).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-doc README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- **PDF CJK fonts are discovered, not bundled** — with no usable system font, CJK text falls back to the built-in Latin font (the create result reports it). The `.ttc` collection path extracts the first face to a temp TTF because pdfkit cannot embed collections.
- **DOCX edits are paragraph-level** — `replace_text` matches inside single `<w:t>` runs (text split across runs does not match); headers, footers, fields and numbering are out of edit scope.
- **No in-place edits for PDF/PPTX/text** — recreate with `create_document` instead.
- **Legacy binary office formats unsupported** — `.doc`/`.xls`/`.ppt` need a user-side conversion first.
